subject: Draft texture ABI follow-up: swizzle sentinel and packer bounded-address contract
body: Current draft hash785f2fec83a4a795 review follow-up: swizzle_word=0 is a valid Mali RRRR swizzle, so using0 as default makes an actual RRRR view impossible; use explicit validity/default sentinel outside12bit domain and reject highbits. Clarify N2T_CHANNEL_* are Mali component IDs (R0,G1,B2,A3,zero4,one5), NOT Metal TextureSwizzle IDs (zero0,one1,R2,G3,B4,A5) used in TeguAIRRenderResource; consumers must convert, not copy. Public pack_sampled/storage should reject backing_address==0 and backing_length==0; internal geometry query may omit bounds, but current shared n2t_layout_check skips range/address-limit validation when length0 and pack forwards that. Test zero/48bit-end/overflow spans and unchanged outputs. first_layer contract issue still requires explicit source-of-truth agreement: if level offsets are already view-relative physical offsets, document first_layer informational and set tests; otherwise add its stride exactly once.
